page.overview:
What is Pepe Kingdom?

The Pepe Kingdom is a kingdom located somewhere in the world. It is extremely impoverished, as it is said that a thousand of its citizens die of hunger each year.

Very little of the Pepe Kingdom has been seen. It appears to have a barren terrain with its buildings being very shoddy, a testament to its destitution.

The Pepe Kingdom has a noted history of poverty and destitution with it being said that it loses a thousand citizens each year to hunger. When the Cross Guild was founded under Buggy, Crocodile, and Dracule Mihawk and started offering monetary bounties for Marines, one Pepe citizen was desperate enough to kill Vice Admiral T Bone which allowed him to feed his family with the reward and welcomed to join Cross Guild.
